reviews.text:
I honestly have nothing but good things to say about The Groom Box in Forest Gate. I only wish we had discovered them sooner!

We had actually used The Groom Room at Pets at Home in Beckton for over 13 years, but unfortunately, the last four years became increasingly frustrating, with nothing but problems. We experienced cancelled appointments, cuts that just weren’t up to scratch, and on occasions, staff who were rude and inconsiderate. After being a loyal customer for so many years, it was really disappointing, and eventually we decided enough was enough and started looking elsewhere.

Then we found The Groom Box — and what a difference!

From the very first visit, I was pleasantly surprised. The Scottish Terrier cut was absolutely unreal — exactly what we wanted, and our dog looked and smelled amazing afterwards. Most importantly, you could tell that she had been genuinely well looked after and cared for while he was there.

The customer service was exceptional from start to finish. Everyone was friendly, professional and clearly passionate about what they do. We genuinely couldn't fault them.

It’s such a relief to finally find somewhere where you feel confident leaving your dog and know they’re going to be treated properly and come out looking fantastic.

I would recommend The Groom Box to absolutely anyone and everyone without hesitation. We are so glad we found them — we definitely won’t be going anywhere else now! 🐶❤️
